title: Fix leakage of log-level in LoggerTests

timeline.message: Fix leakage of log-level in LoggerTests
timeline.author: Moritz Mack

timeline.body:
Fix leakage of log-level in LoggerTests

closes #106250
Does getLevel return null if the effective level is inherited? Otherwise it seems we might force the current parent log level to be realized on this logger when restoring it.

reply.body:
Good point, it's always the effective log level. 
Also, when setting root to DEBUG, all the restricted loggers will be configured with level INFO. So there's a lot more to do to revert any possible changes. I've added a small util `TestLoggers.runWithLoggersRestored` to do that.
